items.text: Nico Collins listed OUT or DOUBTFUL on ETR Sunday fantasy injuries report; Schefter and Rapoport confirm Texans ruled him out with hamstring.
items.why: Hamstring injury; missed practices; official OUT ruling.
items.implication: Massive volume loss for HOU passing game; look to other WRs/TE for targets.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for remaining HOU pass-catchers like Dalton Schultz, Xavier Hutchinson, Kayshon Boutte, Jaylin Noel.

items.text: Zay Flowers (and Ja'Kobi Lane) listed OUT or DOUBTFUL; Schefter/Rap confirm Flowers doubtful for Sunday vs Saints after missing practices with hamstring.
items.why: Hamstring; second straight practice miss; official doubtful.
items.implication: BAL WR depth thinned significantly; hierarchy shifts to backups.
items.opportunity: Rashod Bateman, Devontez Walker elevated; crumbs for others; Mark Andrews target bump possible.

items.text: Brock Bowers listed OUT or DOUBTFUL; Schefter and Rap confirm Raiders list him doubtful (knee) for vs Chargers; practiced Friday after misses.
items.why: Knee injury; HC notes test ahead of game but doubtful designation.
items.implication: If out, Michael Mayer sees heavy TE targets again as in Week 1.
items.opportunity: Michael Mayer elevated role/snaps/routes/targets if Bowers inactive.

items.text: Ladd McConkey listed QUESTIONABLE (ribs); returned to practice Friday after misses; Schefter confirms Q vs Raiders. Levitan calls it biggest injury on slate impacting Herbert projections; 4pm ET start.
items.why: Rib injury from Week 1; limited/missed early practices but back Friday.
items.implication: Major uncertainty for LAC offense and Herbert; monitor active status closely.
items.opportunity: If out, Quentin Johnston and others get target boost; if in, full role expected.

items.text: Ladd McConkey (ribs) is the biggest injury on the slate; affects so many projections including Justin Herbert. Game at 4pm ET. BAL/HOU/NE down to crumbs at WR.
items.why: Ribs status uncertainty cascades to Herbert and LAC offense; multiple key WRs out elsewhere.
items.implication: Major projection volatility; update immediately on news.
items.opportunity: Monitor for active; beneficiaries in LAC if out; WR depth charts thinned league-wide.

items.text: Joe Burrow listed QUESTIONABLE but 'said he's playing'; Schefter confirms Bengals list Q (back) vs HOU; coach indicates good to go.
items.why: Back; Burrow said ridiculous not to play; Taylor positive.
items.implication: Likely plays; CIN offense intact barring setback.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson listed IN; full participant. Levitan notes Patriots desperate for playmakers with AJ Brown IR, questions 10+ touches in 2026 debut vs strong schedule stretch.
items.why: Cleared; 'I'm ready to go' comments; full practice.
items.implication: Potential role expansion vs Stevenson; timing perfect with NE WR injuries.
items.opportunity: 10+ touch potential; explosive plays needed; nice upcoming matchups before bye.

items.text: Patriots desperately need playmakers with AJ Brown (ankle) on IR; do they give TreVeyon Henderson 10+ touches in debut? Returning at right time with nice matchups ahead (PIT, JAX etc before bye). Unclear vs Stevenson.
items.why: NE desperate for explosives; Henderson ready; schedule favorable.
items.implication: Potential early-season RB flex/streamer value if workload materializes.
items.opportunity: Carries, targets, explosive plays; handcuff/backup elevation.

items.text: LOVE Kenneth Walker vs IND: handled 21 of 24 RB touches through 3Q (74% snaps), 40% routes targeted (team lead). IND gave up 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry. 24% target share in first KC game.
items.why: Elite Week 1 utilization (touches, snaps, targets); soft IND run defense matchup; high target share.
items.implication: Must-start RB1 upside; massive season potential.
items.opportunity: High snap share, targets, carries, RZ work.

items.text: LOVE Ashton Jeanty @ LAC: 99 utilization score Week 1 (tied Bijan lead); 19% target share last 10; 25+ touches in 3 of last 4.
items.why: Elite utilization and workload; consistent targets/touches.
items.implication: Strong RB start; overreaction to prior injury scare unwarranted.

items.text: LOVE Bucky Irving vs CLE: RB9 util Week 1, 26% target share, all RB RZ touches; out-routed Gainwell by 8. CLE allowed 121 rush/4.8 YPC.
items.why: Dominant Week 1 role (targets, RZ, routes); soft CLE run D.
items.opportunity: Target share, RZ/goal-line, route participation edge over committee.

items.text: Giving Christian McCaffrey a bump off Week 1 usage regardless, but Kaelon Black (groin) status does matter.
items.why: Strong Week 1 usage; Black status secondary factor.

items.text: LOVE Justin Jefferson @ CHI: 37% target share from Wentz Week 1; 93 rec yds/18.0 PPG avg in 6 career games with Wentz. Bears D allowed 10+ YPT to CAR WRs.
items.why: Massive target share/volume with Wentz; historical production; matchup.

items.text: HATE Travis Etienne @ BAL: matched Kendre Miller rushes Week 1, 69% points via air; Kamara expected back squeezes role further; NO 8.5-pt dogs not run-friendly.
items.why: Committee squeeze with Kamara return; pass-game reliant; tough script/matchup.
